description: Allowlist of every route file under apps/web/app/api/. A new route must be added here in the same PR that lands it, with a purpose and an owner. CI fails if the tree contains any route not present in this list, or any manifest entry not present on disk. This is the deny-by-default construction described in S4b of the Security Elevation Register.

Server-Sent Events bridge from Admin Portal /api/v1/stream to the investor client. Per-event account filtering, strict envelope, auth re-verify on 15s cadence. Dark behind FLAG_ADMIN_PROXY_STREAM.

On-domain two-step signup (F-track). POST step 1 captures email; PATCH step 2 fills qualification fields. Writes to the alpha-application entity on the durable driver. Dark behind FLAG_ALPHA_APPLICATION_ROUTE.

G-track sync point 1 (Sprint 3). Consumes an AlphaHandoffToken (ES256): iss/aud/exp pinned, strict claim schema, single-use jti consumed atomically, one-to-one binding of alphaPlayerId to alpha-application. Dark behind FLAG_ALPHA_CLAIM_ROUTE.

PR-F Surface 4. GET returns current AccountPrefs + version. PATCH applies investor-editable knobs with S8 optimistic concurrency (409 on version mismatch), material-change consent gate, atomic history + receipt append. Dark behind FLAG_ACCOUNT_CONTROLS_CENTER + FLAG_ACCOUNT_PREFS_PATCH.
PR-F Surface 4. AccountPrefs edit history scoped to the caller's account. Writes a RecordAccessLog entry on every read (S4c). Dark behind FLAG_ACCOUNT_CONTROLS_CENTER.

Session logout / revocation (S1 residual, alpha-gate). Adds current session jti to the durable revocation list; clears the session cookie. Every subsequent request bearing the same token fails auth verify at the jti-check seam in auth.ts.
